subject: {first_name}, I built this after one too many "trust me bro" takes
preview_text: We publish every prediction. You can verify us match by match.
body_paragraphs: Every matchday, the same scene plays out: a group chat full of confident opinions — "they're due a win," "home advantage," "I just feel it." Nobody checking form, injuries, or what the numbers actually say.

I built Predictify because football arguments shouldn't be won by whoever talks loudest. We wanted forecasts you can pressure-test: xG, recent form, squad news, and a calibrated confidence score on every pick — 1X2, O/U, BTTS, and more.

A friend of ours learned this the hard way on a Champions League night. The model flagged a favorite at 61% confidence — basically a coin flip dressed up as certainty. He ignored it, went with gut feel, and lost the argument and the bet. Two weeks later he opened a pick in our highest-confidence band (80%+ tier), read the breakdown, and called it before kickoff. Same friend. Different process.
That's why we publish every result — wins and losses — so you can verify the track record yourself, match by match. No hidden picks. No rewriting history after the final whistle.

Your next step takes about 30 seconds: open today's slate, pick one match, and read the reasoning before you lock in your call. If you want the model's strongest read, start with the highest-confidence pick on the board.
P.S. We're not a bookmaker. No guaranteed wins — just transparent forecasts and a record you can check. Gut feel is fun in the chat. Numbers are better before kickoff.
